title: > for this NR sidelink measurement, consider the NR sidelink frequency indicated by the sl-MeasObject associated to this event.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement
entities.description: Measurement procedure for NR sidelink frequency evaluation using event-based triggering conditions with hysteresis and threshold parameters.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement Result
entities.description: The NR sidelink measurement result of the NR sidelink frequency, expressed in dBm for RSRP, without considering any offsets.

entities.name: Hysteresis Parameter
entities.description: Hysteresis parameter for the event (sl-Hysteresis as defined within sl-ReportConfig), expressed in dB.

entities.name: Threshold Parameter
entities.description: Threshold parameter for the event (s2-Threshold as defined within sl-ReportConfig), expressed in the same unit as Ms.

entities.name: sl-MeasObject
entities.description: Object indicating the NR sidelink frequency to be considered for this measurement event.

entities.name: sl-ReportConfig
entities.description: Configuration containing hysteresis (sl-Hysteresis) and threshold (s2-Threshold) parameters for the measurement event.

entities.name: Event Triggering Condition
entities.description: Condition defined by formulas Ms + Hys < Thresh and Ms - Hys > Thresh for measurement event triggering.

relations.description: The measurement procedure considers the NR sidelink frequency indicated by the sl-MeasObject.
The measurement procedure uses parameters defined in sl-ReportConfig.
The event condition uses the measurement result Ms in its formulas.
The event condition uses the hysteresis parameter Hys in its formulas.
The event condition uses the threshold parameter Thresh in its formulas.
The measurement procedure includes evaluation of event triggering conditions.
